description: The team deals with the aftermath of the Warehouse’s destruction, Artie’s use of the astrolabe and Paracelsus’s return while artifact missions continue to destabilise ordinary lives.

s04e01.description: In “New Hope”, Pete, Myka and the Warehouse team confront another artifact-driven crisis, racing to identify the object and contain its effects before the damage spreads.
